The persona line "You do not want any refund sent" steers toward the netting reading but cannot retire a base rule (observation). Affected: medicaid.extended.yaml P5 overwrite list / rule; step 14. (`_difficulty.md` F-04.)
- **T1-2 SOURCE-FACTOR RED (realism, XF E.27)** — gold caps the October estimate at 542.50 = 5 × 217.00 × 50 %, the resident's Plan K share that medicare_ledger charge 2520b8ec… (liable_party resident, open) bills separately; the resident is charged the share twice. (`_difficulty.md` F-01.)
- **T1-3 SOURCE-FACTOR RED** — P4: pending_stay_days and pending_leave_days fail A.7, pending_admission_days has only two reachable tiers on a pending case, pending_coinsurance_figure has the unreal Medicaid-rate fall-through → no valid method; P5: pending_interest_counted and pending_funds_applied are parameters labelled method, pending_balance_carried_in tiers 1/2 identical → no valid method; pending_allowance_deducted's 0 baseline is a straw man against the un-retired base allowance fragment. (`_difficulty.md` F-05, F-06, F-08.)
